mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refunds (refund_id, booking_id, amount, account_number, bank_name) VALUES (#{refundId}, #{booking.bookingId}, #{amount}, #{accountNo}, #{bankName})
mapper.select: SELECT refund_id AS refundId, booking_id AS "booking.bookingId", amount, account_number AS accountNo, bank_name AS bankName FROM refunds
SELECT r.refund_id AS refundId, r.amount, r.account_number AS accountNo, r.bank_name AS bankName FROM refunds r JOIN bookings b ON r.booking_id = b.booking_id WHERE b.flight_id = #{flightId}
